title: This is the parameter network
text: Every open fit is a large blue disc, and every parameter in it is a small disc joined to it by a thin grey line. The colour of a parameter says what it is doing: purple is free, green follows another parameter, grey is fixed. The key is in the top-left corner.

title: Show the fixed parameters too
text: A fixed parameter is not estimated, but it can still be linked — and it is hidden until you ask for it. Tick this to see the whole model.

title: Link two parameters by dragging
text: Drag one parameter node onto another. The one you dragged becomes the follower: it stops being estimated and takes the other's value. That is what makes a fit global — two datasets sharing one lifetime.

title: …or by selecting and pressing Link
text: Click one parameter (it gets a red rim — it is the master), click a second, then press Link. The same thing happens, and it works when the two nodes are far apart.

title: Edit what you selected
text: The Selection panel holds an editor for each selected parameter, captioned with the fit it belongs to — which matters, because two fits of the same model name their parameters identically.

title: Break a link
text: Double-click a cyan arrow in the network, or select the follower and press Unlink. Tick ‘all’ first to clear every link in every fit at once.

title: When the network gets crowded
text: Change the Layout to move the nodes around, raise Spread to push them apart, then use the wheel to zoom and drag the background to pan. ⌖ puts everything back in the panel. Connect base joins the fits and plugin groups to each other, so you can see what is available to link against.

title: Keeping up with the fits
text: The network follows the fits by itself — changes are coalesced, and the layout only re-runs when the shape actually changed, so a running fit costs nothing here. Untick ‘auto’ to take that over, and press ⟳ Refresh when you want it redrawn.

title: Everything at once
text: The Parameters panel is the same information as a table: every parameter of every fit and every plugin group, searchable, with value, bounds, fixed state and which row it follows.

title: Keep the scheme
text: Save writes the network — values, fixed flags and links — as a GraphML file. Loading it applies all three onto the fits you have open, which is how one linking scheme is reused on a new set of datasets.
